PC Errata 2016 disc card of [[Luke's X-34 Landspeeder]]: A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 10 August 2016. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy. Source: Players Committee card image [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/lukesx34landspeeder.gif lukesx34landspeeder.gif] in the starwarsccg.org card lists. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160810103102/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/lukesx34landspeeder.gif Internet Archive] (10 August 2016, the earliest archived copy); the same file was still served on 16 November 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261116052303/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Light/large/lukesx34landspeeder.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Luke's X-34 Landspeeder (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].
